title: Implement a Simple Residual Block with Shortcut Connection
prompt: Implement a function that creates a simple residual block using NumPy. The block should take a 1D input array, process it through two weight layers (using matrix multiplication), apply ReLU activations, and add the original input via a shortcut connection before a final ReLU activation.
